title: Milestones 1-3 + first conformance: PROC1_$TST_LOCK byte-identical
description: Rust workspace + Python conformance harness; lexer/preprocessor/parser with unit tests; minimal semantics+codegen so PROC1_$TST_LOCK (0xE148CA, 0x1C) compiles to bytes identical to the SR10.2 SAU2 image. CLAUDE.md section 8, milestones 1-3 (+ first routine of milestone 4).

title: Rust workspace skeleton + compiler driver + test runner
description: Cargo workspace (crates per phase behind clear interfaces: syntax, sema, ir, m68k backend, driver binary 'dpc'). Empty driver accepting a .pas and writing .s. cargo test wired. Top-level Makefile or script running cargo test + python harness tests.

title: Python conformance harness: assemble/link at image address, compare bytes with SR10.2 image
description: tools/conform.py: assemble .s with m68k-elf-as (-m68010), link with m68k-elf-ld at the routine's image VA with an external-symbol table taken from the SAU2 map (tools/symbols, e.g. PROC1_$CURRENT_PCB 0xE1EAC8), extract bytes, compare with image bytes (offset = VA-0xDFFC00); on mismatch show side-by-side imgdis. Self-test: a hand-written .s for PROC1_$TST_LOCK must pass, a perturbed one must fail.

title: Lexer + % preprocessor with unit tests
description: Ref 2.1 (identifiers with _ and $, case-insensitivity 2.1.6, based integers 16#1c6 2.1.2, three comment forms 2.1.4, string escapes 2.1.5.1) and 4.7 compiler directives (%include with search paths, %if/%ifdef/%else/%elseif/%elseifdef/%endif, %config, %enable, %error, %exit; others tokenised/ignored with TODO issues). Tokens carry source positions.

title: Parser + AST for kernel subset with unit tests
description: Recursive descent. module heading with sections (7.1, 7.1.1), declaration parts in any order (const/type/var/label/define/extern/static, routine_option), types (integer/integer16/integer32, boolean, char, subranges, enums, sets, records incl. variant/packed, arrays, pointers, univ_ptr, procedure pointer types), procedure/function headings with param modes (5.3) and options (5.5), attribute lists [section(..)] (5.7.1), statements and expressions of ch. 4 incl. Domain extensions. One test per construct. No AST interfaces in m68k terms (CLAUDE.md 4.5).

title: Semantics: symbols, types, layout, Table 5-1 parameter conventions (subset for TST_LOCK)
description: Symbol tables with nested scopes, type checking for the subset, data layout (sizes per codegen-patterns 5, record offsets, set sizes/bit order 3.9.3), param-passing decisions per Table 5-1 (default by-address; val_param/internal by value for <=4-byte value/in scalars; univ cancels). Unit tests encode Table 5-1 rows and layout examples.

title: IR + m68k codegen + gas emitter: PROC1_$TST_LOCK byte-identical
description: Lower to IR, select instructions, emit gas for m68k-elf-as -m68010 with explicit sizes. Reproduce 0xE148CA exactly: link.w #-4; movea.l abs.l,A0; move.w (8,A6),D0; move.l (0x40,A0),D1; btst D0,D1; sne D1; move.b D1,D0; unlk; rts. Write tests/conformance/proc1_tst_lock.pas (reconstructed decls from ../source/domain_os/proc1 headers) + golden .s; harness passes.

title: Sema: predeclare remaining built-ins (addr, sizeof, firstof/lastof, succ/pred, discard, set_sr, min/max, in_range)
description: Not predeclared after 0sp.5; kernel code needs addr/sizeof/set_sr at least. Cite ch. 4 entries and Appendix E.

title: IR Width needs signedness (ext vs zero-extend, signed/unsigned compares, divs/divu)
description: Review of 0sp.6. Needed before comparisons/arithmetic; 0..65535 subranges are 2-byte unsigned (sema).

title: Sema: integer16 := 16#FFFF rejected - verify Apollo behaviour
description: Ref 3.4 NOTE allows 16#FFFFFFFF as -1 for integer32; unclear for 16-bit. Find evidence before changing.

title: isel: make selection two-phase so prologue movem knows used callee-saved regs; allocator must keep values live across calls
description: Review of 0sp.6. codegen-patterns 2 and 12 (params loaded into D2-D7/A2-A4 at entry, movem save/restore from frame). Current isel emits prologue first and uses a scratch-only free-after-use allocator. Reshape before milestone 5 (calls).

title: Milestone 6: nested routines, case, sets, M$ARITH, control flow
description: CLAUDE.md section 8 item 6. Conformance: PMAP_$FLUSH 0xE1376C (nested 0xE1359C, 0xE1360C), OSINFO_$GET_MMAP 0xE5C694 (jump table), then XNS_IDP_$GET_STATS 0xE18FD6, MMAP_$ALLOC_CONTIG 0xE0D8F0, SMD_$BUSY_WAIT 0xE1D89E.

title: if/while/repeat, comparisons, boolean tests (tst.b/bmi), and then/or else; explicit branch sizes
description: codegen-patterns 7 (branch sizes .s/.w, boolean tests signed byte), ref 4-18/4-134 short-circuit. Catalogue compare/branch patterns from the image first (Uncertain entries).

title: Named code/data sections (module heading, [section(..)]) and output section naming for ../source link scripts
description: codegen-patterns 11; check ../source linker scripts for expected .text.<NAME> convention; WIRED_PROC/WIRED_DATA.

title: Function results: assignment not in final position, multiple paths, reading result var; pointer results in A0
description: codegen-patterns 3 (Uncertain). Find image examples (MST_$MAPS, NET_$FIND_HANDLER) before coding.

title: Default-convention value parameters: callee local copy
description: Ref 5.2 Table 5-1; find image examples of callee copies of by-address value params (frame offsets, copy sequence).

title: status_$t out-param idioms: clear on entry, move.l #imm error stores, shared epilogue
description: codegen-patterns 9; IO_$ALLOC 0xE1A9C6, SMD_$BUSY_WAIT 0xE1D8AA, MMAP_$ALLOC_CONTIG 0xE0D8FC. Conformance: SMD_$BUSY_WAIT, XNS_IDP_$GET_STATS.

title: Nested routines: static link in A1 vs dynamic link (A6), up-level access, emission before parent: PMAP_$FLUSH
description: codegen-patterns 6. Settle the A1-vs-(A6) rule from more image examples (PROC2_$SUSPEND nested 0xE41214, VFMT_$MAIN, RIP_$SEND, KBD_$RCV) before coding.

title: case statements: word-offset jump table vs cmpi/beq chain: OSINFO_$GET_MMAP
description: codegen-patterns 7 (0xE5C6C0..D6, MAC_OS_$OPEN 0xE0B3AE, KBD_$RCV 0xE1CCFE, TTY_$I_RCV; sparse chain 0xE1CC64). Determine density threshold from the image.

title: 32-bit multiply/div/mod via M$ARITH; inline mulu/muls/divu/divs for 16-bit
description: codegen-patterns 8. Catalogue call sites to settle the inline-vs-M$ rule (0xE07FEE M$OIU$WLW, 0xE13AFC divu.w). Semantics vs ../source/domain_os/math/{mult,div,mod}.c.

title: Sets: in for multi-word sets in memory, set constructors, union/intersection/difference, constant sets
description: codegen-patterns 5.1 (MST_$ALLOC_ASID 0xE42D5C btst byte offset); catalogue set ops in the image first.

title: Interrupt built-ins disable/enable/set_sr
description: codegen-patterns 10 (ori.w #0x700,SR / andi.w #0xF8FF,SR; TIME_$SET_TIME_OF_DAY 0xE167EC..0xE1686A). Ref Appendix E, Table 4-7.

title: Procedure/function pointer calls (movea.l ..,An; jsr (An)) and routine pointer types
description: codegen-patterns 1.6 (0xE0B3F0, 0xE1CE5E); ref 3.13.3.

title: Constants by address: code-section pool, pea (d,PC), move.l (SP),-(SP) reuse; expression temporaries by address
description: codegen-patterns 1.5 (TERM_$SEND_KBD_STRING 0xE1AB0C, TONE_$ENABLE 0xE1ACFC).

title: Sema: array initialisers expand to one InitStore per element
description: Huge [n of v] initialisers cost memory/time; consider run-length InitStore.

title: Emission order: routines declared forward/extern earlier are emitted at declaration, not body position
description: Review of 0sp.6: sema top_routines dedups on first declaration, so a routine declared in an %include'd .ins.pas is emitted before routines whose bodies come first. Bytes won't match the image. Fix in sema: order by body position. Also fix Module::functions doc/TODO in dpc-ir.

title: Parser nesting cap 128 may be low for real code; consider bigger-stack parse thread + driver diagnostic cap
description: Review of 0sp.4 added MAX_DEPTH=128 nesting guard (debug build overflowed ~186 parens on 2MB stack). Each source nesting level may consume several guard levels. Option: run the front end on a thread with a large stack and raise the cap. Also cap number of diagnostics printed by the driver (100k-error garbage case).

title: Stale TODO on sema Routine::frame_size: rounding now lives in dpc-m68k link_size
description: Update the comment in crates/dpc-sema/src/program.rs.

title: After v1: evaluate replacing hand-written parser/plumbing with a library (e.g. chumsky)
description: Owner (2026-10-11): keep hand-written recursive descent for v1; once v1 is done, investigate refactoring to remove code from the repo, e.g. a parser-combinator library (chumsky) over the existing token stream. Check toolchain compatibility (cargo 1.83) and that diagnostics/recovery stay as good. CLAUDE.md 4.1 would need updating.

title: Parse write/writeln field widths (x:w:d)
description: Out of scope (I/O) but many reference example programs use them; parser rejects 'writeln(x:5)'.

title: conform.py literal-address check may false-positive on Pascal numeric constants equal to map addresses
description: Review of domain-pascal-0sp.2 added a check rejecting unrelocated 32-bit fields equal to a map symbol address >= 0x10000. Kernel Pascal may legitimately use numeric constants (hardware addresses, e.g. 16#FF.... constants) that coincide with map symbols. Revisit when a real routine trips it.

title: Sema: reject duplicate variant labels in records
description: '1: (...); 1: (...)' accepted silently (review of 0sp.5).

title: Milestones 4-5: straight-line code, calls, constants, A5, loops, module-local routines
description: CLAUDE.md section 8 items 4-5. Conformance targets: TIME_$Q_INIT_QUEUE 0xE16C5E, PROC1_$GET_LOADAV 0xE14BBA, AST_$PAGE_ZERO 0xE00EEC + module-local 0xE00EB0, LOG_$READ 0xE17800 + module-local 0xE17778.

title: Assignments, constants and record stores through pointers: TIME_$Q_INIT_QUEUE byte-identical
description: Statement sequences, assignment to fields via pointer params, constant materialisation (moveq/clr/move #imm per codegen-patterns 13), byte/word value slots (byte in high half, 0xE16C62). Conformance: TIME_$Q_INIT_QUEUE 0xE16C5E len 0x22 (C: ../source/domain_os/time/q_init_queue.c).

title: Module data via A5 and record assignment: PROC1_$GET_LOADAV byte-identical
description: codegen-patterns 4 (pea (A5); lea abs,A5; restore movea.l (-k,A6),A5) and 5.2 record copy move.l (A0)+,(A1)+ x3. Module var/static/define storage in a data section addressed off A5. Conformance: PROC1_$GET_LOADAV 0xE14BBA len 0x20 (C: proc1/get_loadav.c). Data segment D E254E8 PROC1_.

title: Calls: word-slot pushes, pad, caller pop/skip, jsr/bsr, constant args: AST_$PAGE_ZERO + 0xE00EB0 byte-identical
description: codegen-patterns 1.1-1.6: right-to-left pushes, subq.l #2,SP pad, addq/lea pop, pop skipped before unlk, pea (n).w and merged adjacent word constants, internal routine by value, bsr.s within module, jsr abs.l across. dbf clear loop with 0x2048 loop-head filler (needs rfd). Conformance: 0xE00EB0 len 0x3C + AST_$PAGE_ZERO 0xE00EEC len 0x2A (C: misc/zero_page.c, ast/page_zero.c).

title: Loops, word arithmetic, 1-based arrays, run-time dbf: LOG_$READ + 0xE17778 byte-identical
description: codegen-patterns 7 (for-loop dbf, subq.w #1; bmi guard, loop-head alignment), 5.2 (1-based arrays folding -1 into displacement), by-address entry calling by-value worker, A5 inherited by worker, clr.w -(SP). Conformance: module-local 0xE17778 len 0x88 + LOG_$READ 0xE17800 len 0x28 (C: log/read.c, log/read_internal.c).

title: Add PROC1_$GET_LOCKS (0xE148E6) as a compiled conformance unit
description: Reviewer found it already compiles byte-identical (variant-record field read through extern pointer). Blocked on domain-pascal-rfd: a TST_LOCK+GET_LOCKS unit gets a spurious section-end 0x2048 (size ours 0x30, image 0x2E).

title: conform.py: scratch dir collides for units with the same stem; OK lines indistinguishable
description: tmp/conform/<stem> shared by tests/conformance/proc1_tst_lock.pas and handasm/proc1_tst_lock.s. Include path in scratch dir name and in OK line.

title: Loop-head 0x2048 alignment when a conformance unit starts at VA not 4-aligned
description: Loop heads are 4-aligned with 0x2048 relative to absolute address (module code base 4-aligned; codegen-patterns 7). Also: the emitter appends .balignw 4,0x2048 at the end of every code section (module-end padding, 0xE1A9D2/0xE1AD16), but a conformance unit that is a fragment of a module must not get it (TST_LOCK+GET_LOCKS: size ours 0x30 vs image 0x2E). Decide: compile whole modules, a dpc 'fragment/origin' option, or harness handling. Raised by 0sp.2 and 0sp.6 reviews.

title: Owner rulings needed: open reference questions (1-10, 12-14)
description: See docs/reference-clarifications.md 'Open questions' items 1-8. Conservative choices implemented, marked TODO(ref-question) in crates/dpc-syntax/src/.
